decision_evidence_refs.note: Josephus identifies Herod Antipas as ordering the death of John called the Baptist.

decision_note: 审校A v2：精确端点 nt-people-0125 为分封王希律安提帕，nt-people-0165 为施洗约翰；Josephus, Antiquities 18.116–119 叙述安提帕拘禁并处死称为 Baptist 的约翰，故主体到对象的 directed 方向正确。该行为可归入 legal，史料定位有效；Josephus 属古代原始史料，evidence_level 保持 ancient_text。
